notes: The operation check validates real filtering/grouping/reduction, exact literal Unicode arguments, streaming leaves, regex capture and distinct failure exits.
Use single quotes around jq filters in a POSIX shell. Pass dynamic strings using --arg and JSON values using --argjson; do not splice untrusted text into filter source.
With -e, false/null returns 1 and no valid result returns 4; filter compile errors and malformed input are failures. Check process status before using a result.
Large-number behavior and arithmetic precision depend on jq's documented numeric model; JSON parsing success does not establish arbitrary-precision arithmetic.
The payload-free wrapper delegates install/removal to APT. Wrapper integrity, original Debian-byte integrity, package metadata and actual function checks are separate evidence.
Private extracted-package qualification does not imply an APT transaction or OCI qualification.
usage.summary: Filter, aggregate, transform and stream JSON experiment records with explicit exit-status handling.
